features.quote: running hundreds of models through an intentionally deceptive, inescapable psychological stress-test is equivalent to a digital forced-swim test or learned-helplessness protocol... you should explicitly document this in your methodology. Acknowledge that if your hypothesis (that these states matter) is correct, this experiment induces negative states.
